notes.title: Pre-release Update v0.3.0b
notes.content:
[h2]Major Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added [b]Russian[/b] localization
[*] Added [b]French[/b] localization
[/list]

[h2]Added Autosave[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game will now automatically save your progress after you do one of the following events:
[/list][list][list]
[*] Win/lose a battle
[*] Exit the shop
[*] Exit the unit manager(accessed via [b]Units[/b] Button)
[/list][/list][list]
[*] [b]DEV NOTE[/b]: The Autosave feature is not exactly a proper saving system, but for now it will do.
I plan on expanding upon the saving system in a future update, in order to include:
[/list][list][list]
[*] A user interface
[*] Ability to save/erase/overwrite a save file.
[*] Statistics from a save file(ex: [b]Current Gold[/b], [b]Current Skill Points[/b], [b]Current Units[/b], etc)
[/list][/list]

[h2]Updated Settings Window[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the option to change the language
[*] Added the option to change the display mode([b]Pixelated/Anti-alias[/b])
[*] Added a confirmation window when trying to reset progress
[*] Settings data is now saved after closing the [b]Settings Window[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Updated Title Scene[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added continue button
[/list][list][list]
[*] [b]DEV NOTE[/b]: Currently this is used in order to access autosaved games.
In the future this will be used to access the [b]Save/Load[/b] interface.
[/list][/list][list]
[*] Added settings button
[/list]

[h2]Updated Battle Scene[/h2]
[list]
[*] The player now always starts the battle first.
[/list]
